name: delta-a
prompt: Using the reference image ONLY for its material, glossy white plastic finish, specular highlight style, soft rounded modelling and top-down view: create a different aircraft, a sleek supersonic delta-wing jet glyph on a fully transparent background, seen exactly from directly above, nose pointing to the upper right at 45 degrees, centred, filling about 65 percent of the frame, leaving room behind it. Very long needle nose, slim fuselage, one large smooth ogival delta wing with softly rounded tips, no tailplane, a slim fin line. From two small rounded exhaust nozzles at the rear, two short soft flame trails stream backwards toward the lower left: glowing coral orange to warm yellow core, fading smoothly to transparent. Smooth toy-like glyph, no detail. No shadow, no background.

name: ribbon-a
prompt: A single smooth glossy ribbon on a fully transparent background, like a soft 3D app icon element: a flat wide band made of six parallel coloured stripes (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet) that enters from the bottom left corner of the frame and sweeps in one gentle S curve up to the centre of the frame, where it ends cleanly and squarely, as if trailing behind an object at the centre. Glossy satin plastic with a soft specular highlight along the curve, slight soft twist, colours saturated but elegant. Nothing else in the image. No shadow, no background.

name: globe-a
prompt: Square app icon background plate, full bleed, edge to edge: near-black charcoal space (#141416 at top) with lots of empty dark space. Across the bottom third, the curved edge of a tiny dark planet seen from orbit at night: a smooth dark navy-charcoal sphere whose top edge arcs gently across the frame, with a thin soft warm coral and orange atmospheric rim light along the horizon, and a few dozen tiny warm golden city light dots sparsely clustered on the dark surface. Minimal, abstract, soft, clean, like a premium app icon background, not a photograph. Empty upper two thirds. No aircraft, no stars, no text.
